{{Quote|When asked how he wanted his X-wing decorated, he'd chosen to make it over the in the image of a krayt dragon, the most fearsome predator on all of Tatooine|[[Farl Cort]] observing Gavin's X-wing.|<ref name="BW" />}}
'''Gavin Darklighter's T-65 X-wing''' was a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] purchased for the [[Human/Legends|human]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]], [[Gavin Darklighter]], after he chose to relinquish his commission to the [[New Republic Defense Fleet/Legends|New Republic Navy]] when the New Republic refused to liberate the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Thyferra/Legends|Thyferra]] from [[Ysanne Isard]] after she became the "legitimate" ruler of the world. Alongside the former members of [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]], Gavin was given the chance to customise his own [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing]] so that the newly formed [[Antilles's Rogues]] appeared distinct from the New Republic. Gavin chose to paint the hull of his [[Snubfighter/Legends|snubfighter]] with a [[Color/Legends|reddish-orange]] scale pattern to mimic the visage of the krayt dragons from his homeworld of Tatooine.<ref name="BW" />
